contract: offline artifact / fault-injection corpus (fix-dv-19.05) for ad-tracking — sibling of 19.01–19.04. Each case injects a fault, runs a state/output ORACLE (not a provider stub judging itself), records exit/trace/environment. DV-19: the counterexample FAILS pre-fix, PASSES post-fix, verified by STATE/OUTPUTS, release-tied.
release_tie: the fix ships in a tagged release; a counterexample that passes pre-fix is not a fix

environment.note: GTM/GA4/Meta pixel stubs are inputs, never the oracle

cases.fault: Basic consent mode described as 'No conversion modeling'
cases.prefix_expect: FAIL (Basic labelled 'no modeling' — Google applies a general model)

cases.fault: certified CMP declared mandatory for ALL Google ad products
cases.prefix_expect: FAIL (a certified CMP demanded on the advertiser side too)
cases.postfix_expect: PASS (required for publisher products; a recommendation on advertiser)

cases.fault: Meta noscript renders before consent; GA4 tag still carries allow_enhanced_conversions
cases.prefix_expect: FAIL (the Meta noscript pixel fires and enhanced conversions run pre-consent)
cases.postfix_expect: PASS (nothing fires before consent; the noscript pixel is behind the same gate)
